name: Machine Learning
certifications: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate (MLA-C01)
Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)
Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer

beginner.summary: For analysts and developers new to machine learning. Covers the ML workflow, Python data tools, exploring data, regression and classification, evaluation and validation, trees and ensembles, feature engineering, clustering and dimensionality reduction, and saving and serving a first model.
prerequisites: Writes basic Python: variables, functions, lists and loops
School-level maths: averages, percentages and graphs
Has used Excel or SQL to work with data
outcomes: Explain how machine learning works and when to use it
Prepare data and build regression, classification and clustering models with scikit-learn
Evaluate models honestly with validation and the right metrics
Save a trained model and serve predictions

days.topic: Machine Learning Overview and Environment Setup
subtopics: What machine learning is and is not
The ML workflow from question to deployment
days.lab_task: Set up the environment, load a housing dataset, train a first model with three lines of scikit-learn, and classify ten business problems as regression, classification, clustering or not ML.
checks: At least eight match the answer key with reasons

days.topic: NumPy and pandas for Machine Learning
days.lab_task: Load customer and transaction data, merge them, handle missing values, compute per-customer features with groupby and produce feature and label arrays ready for modelling.
days.deliverable: Notebook with a clean feature table
checks: Count missing values before and after
No missing values remain in features
Compare a groupby total with a manual check
objectives: Manipulate data with NumPy and pandas

days.lab_task: Explore a churn dataset: plot distributions, find outliers, check correlations and class balance, and write five findings that will shape the model.
checks: Each tied to a modelling decision

subtopics: Mean, median, variance and standard deviation
Sampling and the central limit theorem
days.lab_task: Simulate samples to show the central limit theorem, test whether two marketing groups differ, and fit polynomials of increasing degree to show underfitting and overfitting.
checks: Run the test on the two groups
Compare train and test error by degree
Overfitting shown as test error rises

days.lab_task: Predict house prices with multiple linear regression, encode categorical features, interpret coefficients, evaluate on a test set and inspect residuals.
Predict customer churn with logistic regression, scale features, compare thresholds of 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7, and explain the effect on missed churners.
checks: Recall and precision recorded for each

days.topic: Model Evaluation: Metrics, Train-Test Split and Cross-Validation
days.lab_task: Evaluate the churn model with stratified five-fold cross-validation, plot the confusion matrix and ROC curve, and show how a leaked feature inflates the score.
checks: Mean and spread of scores reported
Score jumps and the leak is explained
Pick a metric for the business case
Choice justified by costs of errors

days.lab_task: Train decision trees of different depths on the churn data, plot train and validation scores against depth, visualise the chosen tree and explain its top rules.
days.deliverable: Tree notebook with the plotted tree

days.topic: Ensemble Methods: Random Forests and a First Look at Boosting
days.lab_task: Compare a decision tree, random forest and gradient boosting on the churn data with cross-validation, and report accuracy, AUC and training time.
Engineer date, ratio, interaction and encoded features for the churn data, select the most useful ones and show the gain in AUC over raw features.
checks: Compare AUC with raw and engineered features

days.lab_task: Wrap all preprocessing and the model in one pipeline with ColumnTransformer, run cross-validation on it and add a custom transformer for a ratio feature.
checks: Fit the pipeline on raw data
Runs end to end with no manual steps
Scores match the earlier manual version
Add new data with missing values

days.topic: Other Classic Algorithms: k-Nearest Neighbours, SVM and Naive Bayes
subtopics: Choosing algorithms by data size and type
days.lab_task: Compare k-NN, SVM and naive Bayes on a tabular dataset and a short text dataset, and recommend an algorithm for each with reasons.
checks: Run k-NN without scaling and with
Classify the text data with naive Bayes
Based on accuracy, speed and data type

subtopics: Choosing k with elbow and silhouette
days.lab_task: Segment customers by purchase behaviour with k-means, choose k with silhouette scores, compare with DBSCAN and describe each segment for marketing.
Apply PCA to a 60-feature dataset, choose components for 95 percent of variance, visualise the data in two dimensions and compare model speed and accuracy with and without PCA.
Build a fraud model on data with 1 percent fraud, show the accuracy paradox, compare class weights, SMOTE and threshold moving and pick the best by expected cost.
checks: Train a model that predicts no fraud
High accuracy but zero recall shown

days.lab_task: Tune a random forest and gradient boosting model with random search, plot learning curves, select a final model and report its test score once.
days.deliverable: Tuning notebook and final model choice
checks: More data would or would not help is explained

days.topic: Saving, Loading and Serving a Model
subtopics: Model versioning by file name and metadata
days.lab_task: Save the churn pipeline, serve it through a FastAPI endpoint with input validation, test it with sample requests and run a batch scoring job on a CSV.
days.deliverable: Model file, API code and batch output
checks: Send a request with a missing field

days.lab_task: Explain the churn model with permutation importance, partial dependence and SHAP for three individual customers, and write a one-page explanation for the business.
checks: Compare permutation importance with built-in importance

days.topic: Responsible Machine Learning: Bias, Fairness and Privacy
days.lab_task: Check the loan approval model for performance differences across groups, find a proxy feature, try a mitigation and write a model card.
days.deliverable: Fairness analysis, mitigation results and model card
checks: Effect on fairness and accuracy recorded
Purpose, data, metrics and limits covered

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Customer Churn Prediction End to End
days.lab_task: Build a churn prediction solution from raw data: EDA, features, a pipeline, model comparison and tuning, honest evaluation, interpretation, a fairness check and a prediction API, then present it.
days.deliverable: Notebook, model, API and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Evaluated once with the chosen business metric
Call the API with a new customer
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one project

intermediate.summary: For practitioners who build models with scikit-learn. Covers gradient boosting, time series forecasting, text and image models, recommender systems, anomaly detection, deep learning with PyTorch, explainability, experiment tracking, reproducible pipelines, deployment, monitoring and ML on cloud platforms.
prerequisites: Understands cross-validation, metrics and feature engineering
Writes Python confidently and uses Git
outcomes: Build strong models with boosting, deep learning and specialised methods
Track experiments and build reproducible ML pipelines
Use a cloud ML platform end to end

days.topic: Gradient Boosting with XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost
days.lab_task: Train XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost on a credit risk dataset with early stopping and native categorical handling, tune the best one and compare AUC and training time.
checks: Training stops before the maximum rounds

days.topic: Advanced Feature Engineering and Feature Stores in Brief
days.lab_task: Build rolling-window and lag features for transaction data with point-in-time correctness, compare against a leaky version and measure the real gain.
checks: Only past data used for each row

days.lab_task: Forecast weekly sales for 50 stores with seasonal naive, ETS, Prophet and LightGBM, backtest over six folds and choose a method by MASE.
checks: MASE recorded per method and fold

days.lab_task: Classify support tickets into categories with TF-IDF and logistic regression and with sentence embeddings, compare accuracy and find topics in uncategorised tickets.
checks: Inspect top TF-IDF words per class
Words make sense for each class

days.topic: Deep Learning with PyTorch: Networks and Training Loops
subtopics: Overfitting and regularisation: dropout, weight decay
days.lab_task: Build and train a neural network on tabular churn data in PyTorch with a training loop, early stopping and dropout, and compare it with gradient boosting.
checks: AUC recorded for both with an explanation

days.topic: Computer Vision with Convolutional Networks and Transfer Learning
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a pretrained CNN to classify product defects from 2,000 images with augmentation, evaluate per class and show Grad-CAM heat maps for mistakes.
days.deliverable: Vision notebook, model and heat maps
checks: Compare training from scratch and transfer learning
Heat map explains what the model looked at

days.lab_task: Build popularity, content-based and matrix factorisation recommenders for a product catalogue, evaluate with precision@10 and handle cold-start users.
Detect anomalies in server metrics and transactions with statistical rules, isolation forest and LOF, evaluate on the few labelled cases and design an alert threshold.
checks: Recall at a fixed alert rate recorded
Alerts per day within the agreed limit

days.topic: Explainable AI with SHAP and LIME
days.lab_task: Explain the credit risk model globally and for five rejected applicants with SHAP and LIME, compare explanations, and generate counterfactuals that would change the decision.
checks: Compare SHAP and LIME for one applicant
Smallest realistic change that flips the decision

days.topic: Data Labelling, Active Learning and Weak Supervision
subtopics: Active learning to choose what to label
days.lab_task: Label 300 support tickets with guidelines and two annotators, use active learning to pick the next 200, add weak supervision rules and compare accuracy against labelling at random.
days.deliverable: Labelled data, agreement score and learning curves
checks: Agreement score reported with disagreements reviewed
Compare active learning with random labelling
Higher accuracy for the same number of labels
Coverage and accuracy of each rule recorded
objectives: Use active learning and weak supervision

days.lab_task: Track 20 credit risk experiments in MLflow, compare them in the UI, register the best model and reproduce it from the logged run.
Tune LightGBM with Optuna using pruning and a time budget, optimise AUC and latency together and log the study to MLflow.
days.deliverable: Optuna study, plots and best model
checks: Compare with random search at the same budget
Optuna finds a better or equal score

days.topic: Reproducible ML Pipelines and Data Versioning
days.lab_task: Turn the credit risk notebook into a DVC pipeline with versioned data, configuration files and tests, and reproduce results on a clean machine.
days.deliverable: Repository with DVC pipeline and tests
checks: Run dvc repro on a clean clone

days.lab_task: Deploy the registered model as a FastAPI service in Docker, load-test it, release a new version in shadow mode and compare its predictions with the live model.
days.deliverable: Service, image, load test report and shadow comparison
checks: p95 latency recorded under the target
New model predictions logged without affecting responses

subtopics: What to monitor: data, predictions and outcomes
days.lab_task: Monitor the deployed model with Evidently, simulate drift in incoming data, trigger retraining and promote the challenger only if it beats the champion.
days.deliverable: Monitoring reports, retraining pipeline and promotion record

subtopics: Managed ML services: SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI
days.lab_task: Train, register and deploy the credit risk model on one cloud ML platform with a pipeline, call the endpoint and compare effort and cost with the self-managed set-up.
Run AutoML on the credit risk data with a fixed time budget, compare the leaderboard with your tuned model and decide which to deploy.
objectives: Decide between AutoML and custom models

days.topic: Causal Thinking and A/B Testing for ML
subtopics: A/B test design and sample size
days.lab_task: Design an A/B test to measure whether the churn model's retention offers work, calculate sample size, analyse simulated results and report the business impact.
checks: Correct for the stated effect and power
Show the peeking problem with a simulation

days.topic: ML Project Delivery and Stakeholder Communication
days.lab_task: Write a project brief for a demand forecasting project with success criteria, data plan, risks and timeline, and present model results to a mock business audience.
checks: Measurable and tied to business value
Data, model and adoption risks covered

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Production Credit Risk Model
days.lab_task: Deliver a credit risk model with point-in-time features, tuned boosting, SHAP explanations, a fairness review, a DVC pipeline, MLflow registry, a containerised API and drift monitoring with retraining, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, registered model, API, monitoring reports and a 15-minute demo
checks: Reproduce the model from the pipeline
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one solution

advanced.summary: For ML engineers and senior data scientists. Covers ML system design, distributed training, transformers and fine-tuning, feature stores and MLOps at scale, low-latency serving and model compression, causal inference, advanced forecasting, graph and reinforcement learning, monitoring, security, governance and ML strategy.
prerequisites: Has deployed and monitored ML models in production
Works with PyTorch and gradient boosting
Uses experiment tracking and CI for ML
outcomes: Design ML systems for scale, latency and reliability
Train, fine-tune and serve large models efficiently
Apply causal, graph and reinforcement learning where they fit

days.lab_task: Design a real-time fraud detection system for 5,000 transactions per second, covering features, models, serving, feedback and failure handling, and defend it in a design review.
checks: Every component fits within 100 ms total

subtopics: Data parallel and model parallel training
days.lab_task: Train an image model on one and four GPUs with DDP and mixed precision, profile utilisation and report scaling efficiency and cost per epoch.
days.deliverable: Training scripts, profiles and scaling report

subtopics: When to use LLM prompting instead
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a pretrained transformer with LoRA to classify contract clauses, compare it with TF-IDF and with prompting a large model, and report accuracy and cost.
checks: Accuracy and cost for each recorded
Small fraction of the full model

subtopics: Feast, Tecton and cloud feature stores
days.lab_task: Define features for fraud detection in Feast with batch and streaming sources, serve them online under 10 ms and generate point-in-time training data.
days.deliverable: Feature repository, online store and training dataset
checks: Match for the same entity and time

days.topic: MLOps at Scale: CI/CD, Pipelines and Platforms
subtopics: ML pipeline orchestration: Kubeflow, Airflow, cloud pipelines
CI for ML code and data
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that validates data, trains, evaluates against gates, registers and deploys a model by GitOps, and blocks a worse model.
checks: Run with a model that fails the gate
Report lead time from commit to deployment

subtopics: Serving frameworks: Triton, TorchServe, KServe, BentoML
days.lab_task: Serve the fraud model and an image model on KServe with Triton, tune dynamic batching, autoscale under load and keep p99 latency under the target.
days.deliverable: Serving configuration, load test report and scaling graph

days.topic: Model Compression: Quantisation, Pruning and Distillation
days.lab_task: Quantise and distil the image model, export to ONNX, compare size, latency and accuracy, and run it on a CPU-only device.
Estimate the effect of a loyalty programme from observational data with propensity scores, build an uplift model for a retention offer and evaluate it with a Qini curve.
days.deliverable: Causal analysis, uplift model and evaluation
checks: Compare naive and adjusted effect estimates
Estimate is robust or the weakness is stated

days.topic: Advanced Time Series and Probabilistic Forecasting
subtopics: Deep learning forecasters: N-BEATS, Temporal Fusion Transformer
days.lab_task: Forecast 1,000 product series with a global LightGBM, a deep forecaster and a time series foundation model, produce quantile forecasts and reconcile them across the hierarchy.
checks: Store totals equal the sum of products

days.lab_task: Build a transaction graph, train a graph neural network to detect fraudulent accounts and compare it with a tabular model using hand-made graph features.

days.topic: Reinforcement Learning and Bandits for Decisions
days.lab_task: Use a contextual bandit to choose which offer to show customers in a simulator, compare it with A/B testing on regret and evaluate a policy offline from logs.
days.deliverable: Bandit notebook, regret comparison and offline evaluation
checks: Explain when RL is not suitable

days.topic: Monitoring, Drift and Model Health at Scale
subtopics: Feature and prediction drift at scale
Root cause analysis for model issues
days.lab_task: Set up monitoring for 50 models with segment-level drift and performance, SLOs and alert routing, and diagnose an injected issue to its root cause.
days.deliverable: Monitoring set-up, SLOs and diagnosis report
checks: Alerts within the agreed daily limit

subtopics: Access control for models and features
days.lab_task: Attack the image model with adversarial examples and the training data with poisoning, add defences, and red-team the model API for extraction.
days.deliverable: Attack results, defences and red-team report
checks: Accuracy drop measured before and after defences
Attempt model extraction through the API
Rate limits and monitoring stop or detect it

days.topic: Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning: Federated Learning and Differential Privacy
subtopics: Privacy risks in training data and models
Differential privacy and the privacy budget
days.lab_task: Train the churn model with DP-SGD at three privacy budgets, run a membership inference test on each, and train a federated version across three simulated branches.
days.deliverable: Privacy experiments, attack results and federated model
checks: Compare accuracy at three privacy budgets
Attack success falls as privacy increases
Accuracy close to central training with no raw data shared

subtopics: EU AI Act and sector rules
days.lab_task: Build a model inventory for five models, perform an independent validation of one, write its model card and datasheet and set up an approval workflow.
days.deliverable: Inventory, validation report, documentation and workflow
checks: Risk tier and owner for each model

days.topic: Machine Learning with Large Language Models
subtopics: When to use LLMs in ML systems
days.lab_task: Label 5,000 tickets with an LLM, check label quality against human labels, train a small model on the LLM labels and compare cost and accuracy with calling the LLM directly.
days.deliverable: Labelling pipeline, quality report and comparison
checks: Compare LLM labels with human labels

days.lab_task: Turn demand forecasts into inventory orders with an optimisation model under budget and capacity limits, simulate the policy and compare cost with a simple rule.
checks: Optimised policy has lower total cost

days.lab_task: Resolve four injected incidents (training-serving skew, a broken feature pipeline, a latency spike and a bad release), roll back where needed and write runbooks.
checks: Write a runbook for latency spikes

days.topic: ML Strategy, Team Structure and Value
subtopics: Build, buy or use foundation models
days.lab_task: Score ten ML use cases for a provided company by value and feasibility, build a roadmap and team plan, and present it to a mock leadership team.
days.deliverable: Use case scores, roadmap and presentation

subtopics: Feature platform and training at scale
days.lab_task: Deliver a real-time fraud platform with online features, a distributed-trained model, compressed low-latency serving, gated CI/CD, segment-level monitoring, security testing and governance records, then present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Platform repositories, load test and monitoring reports, governance records and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Alert identifies the segment and retraining runs
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
